name: longform-batch-delivery
whatsNew: v9.2 runs the loop the way Chatbox actually provides one. Work Mode is itself a think-call-read-repeat loop; the only hard boundary is a built-in pause every 25 consecutive tool calls. So the skill now forbids ending a message between chunks (prose is always written through a tool call), requires Work Mode, and computes how many Continue clicks a job needs: init prints 'expected Continue clicks N'. New calibrate command recomputes x from measured chars-per-chunk. v9 added the round contract x = target / (cap x 0.8) with a four-phase loop (GENERATE/AUDIT/REPAIR/DONE); gate stays the only legal definition of done (0=DONE / 1=keep writing / 2=fix first).
